questions.question: This medicine was __proscribed __two years ago. (The underlined word means)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **forbidden**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"proscribed"** means something that is forbidden, banned, or not allowed by law or authority. (निषिद्ध)

 
 
• **Example:** The government has proscribed the use of certain pesticides that harm the environment.
 
 
 
• The correct word here is **"forbidden"**, which means not permitted, especially by law or regulation. (निषेध)
 
 
• **Example:** Smoking is forbidden in public places.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **forbidden**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Developed** (विकसित): Something that has grown or evolved over time.

 
 
• **Example:** The country has developed significantly in the last decade.
 
 
 
• **Industrially manufactured** (औद्योगिक रूप से निर्मित): Something that is produced in large quantities in factories.
 
 
• **Example:** These medicines are industrially manufactured to meet high demand.

questions.question:
Give synonym of underlined word:

He sat there __disparaging__ about the legal system.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**Belittling**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is "**disparaging**".
 
• "**Disparaging**" means speaking about someone or something in a disrespectful way; expressing that they are of little worth. (तिरस्कारपूर्ण / नीचा दिखाने वाला)
 
 
• **Example**: She made disparaging comments about his work.
 
 
 
• "**Belittling**" means making someone or something seem unimportant or less valuable. (तुच्छ दिखाना / नीचा दिखाना)
 
 
• **Example**: He kept belittling his colleague in front of others.
 
 
 
• "**Disparaging**" and "**Belittling**" are closest in meaning as both indicate lowering someone’s worth through negative remarks.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Praising**: expressing approval or admiration. (प्रशंसा करना)
 
• **Criticizing**: expressing disapproval or pointing out faults. (आलोचना करना)
 
• **Lecturing**: giving a formal talk or scolding at length. (व्याख्यान देना / समझाना)

questions.question:
Identify the most appropriate synonym of the following word.

Implicate
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"implicate"** means to show someone to be involved in a crime or to convey indirectly. (फंसाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The evidence found at the scene implicates him in the robbery.
 
 
 
• **"Accuse" **refers to charging someone with a crime or wrongdoing. (आरोप लगाना)
 
 
• **Example: **She was accused of stealing money from the office.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'implicate' **is **'accuse'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Complain **(शिकायत करना): To express dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.

 
 
• **Example:** She always complains about the food in the cafeteria.
 
 
 
• **Interrogate **(पूछताछ करना ): To ask questions closely, aggressively, or formally.
 
 
• **Example: **The police interrogated the suspect for hours.
 
 
 
• **Confuse** (उलझन में डालना): To make someone unable to think clearly.
 
 
• **Example:** The complicated instructions confused everyone.

questions.question: Choose the word which best expresses the meaning of the given word: ‘Corpulent’
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Obese**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Corpulent"** means having a large bulky body; fat. (मोटा)

 
 
• **Example: **The corpulent man found it difficult to find clothes that fit him properly.
 
 
 
• **"Obese" **refers to being extremely overweight, often to the point of being unhealthy. (मोटापा)
 
 
• **Example: **The doctor advised the obese patient to start a healthier diet and exercise regimen.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Corpulent' **is **'Obese'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Obese**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lean **(पतला): Having little fat; thin.

 
 
• **Example:** The athlete had a lean and muscular build.
 
 
 
• **Gaunt **(कृश): Extremely thin and bony, often due to illness or starvation.
 
 
• **Example: **After weeks of illness, he looked gaunt and weak.
 
 
 
• **Emaciated** (दुर्बल): Abnormally thin or weak, especially because of illness or lack of food.
 
 
• **Example:** The emaciated dog was found wandering the streets.
 
 

**Question:** Choose the word which best expresses the meaning of the given word: 'Corpulent'

**Correct Answer:** Obese
